basics.name: Ryan Dormanesh
basics.label: Game Designer · Founder, Funtownarcade Games
basics.summary: Game designer with 20+ years in games, from QA and technical design on Rockstar's Red Dead Redemption to level design and live ops on mobile hits like Cookie Jam and Tropical Treats. Founder of Funtownarcade Games LLC, an independent studio in Washington State.

work.name: Funtownarcade Games LLC
work.summary: Independent studio in Washington State. Released Caveman Runner 2.0 for iPhone; developing NumMerge (planned November 2026), Treasure Drop, Every Card Counts Solitaire, and Hexa.

work.name: Freelance
work.summary: Led mobile game and interactive fitness projects end to end, from client requirements and scope through documentation, timelines, and delivery, including a polished mobile puzzle game with online features.

work.name: ESTsoft Inc. · Perfect Swing - Golf
work.summary: Ran live operations for Perfect Swing - Golf on iOS and Android, led QA for global launches, managed a remote QA team, and led App Store and Google Play submissions that earned featured placements.

work.name: MobilityWare · Tropical Treats
work.summary: Designed levels, modes, and obstacles in Unity for a match-3 puzzle game and championed seasonal events and a mission system that helped double the game's revenue. Managed a team of five.

work.name: Jam City · Cookie Jam Series
work.summary: Designed and tuned match-3 levels for Cookie Jam and Cookie Jam Blast, delivering weekly content to millions of players and writing specs for live event features that boosted KPIs.

work.name: BrickLink (The LEGO Group)
work.summary: Managed quality for a global LEGO marketplace with 400,000 users and 9,000 active stores, including test plans, cross-browser and mobile testing, and Selenium automation.

work.name: Checkpoint Studios · AviNation
work.summary: Designed gameplay mechanics, economy, and quests for a social airport simulator, scripted mechanics in C# in Unity, and led the QA department.

work.name: Zynga · FarmVille & Café World
work.position: QA Project Lead / Quality Engineer II
work.summary: Led QA for all Café World content releases to over 2 million daily players and managed localization testing for FarmVille. Voted "Chef of the Week" by the team.

work.name: Rockstar San Diego · Red Dead Redemption
work.summary: Built 600+ dynamic ambient animations and AI state machines that brought the world's people and animals to life, and trained and led a team of designers on in-house tools.

work.name: Rockstar San Diego · Rockstar Presents Table Tennis
work.summary: Directed 15 QA analysts and two remote teams, ran Microsoft certification assessments for the Xbox 360 launch, and supported focus group testing.

work.name: Rockstar San Diego · Midnight Club 3: Dub Edition
work.summary: Found and documented gameplay, crash, and multiplayer bugs, and tracked Sony's Technical Certification Requirements through sign-off.

projects.name: Caveman Runner 2.0
projects.summary: The 2011 iPhone endless runner, rebuilt for today's iPhones with 120 Hz play and iPhone Duo support.

projects.name: NumMerge
projects.summary: A puzzle game about chaining numbered balls in order to merge them. Planned for the App Store and Google Play in November 2026.

projects.name: Guess Quest
projects.summary: A high or low card betting game made in one day.

projects.name: Caveman Runner (original)
projects.summary: An early iPhone endless runner, co-developed with Tom Carroll.
